page.help: Give away a prize to random members. Mewvo posts a giveaway message with a button, members press it to enter, and when time is up Mewvo picks the winners. Reroll picks new winners. Everything here needs the Administrator permission in this server.

needsAdmin: To run giveaways you need the Administrator permission in this server.

create.title: Start a giveaway
create.help: Mewvo posts the giveaway message in the channel you pick. You can also do this with /giveaway create in Discord.
create.channelHelp: Where the giveaway message is posted.
create.prizeHelp: What the winners get, for example Nitro for one month.
create.durationHelp: How long members can enter. A number and a letter: s (seconds), m (minutes), h (hours) or d (days). From 10 seconds to 30 days.
create.winnersHelp: How many members win. From {min} to {max}.

list.endConfirm: End this giveaway now and pick the winners?
list.deleteConfirm: Delete the "{prize}" giveaway and its message?

random.title: Pick a random member
random.help: Picks one random member, for example for a quick draw. The result shows at the top of this page and is saved in the dashboard history. Nothing is posted in Discord. You can also do this with /tools randomuser in Discord.
random.botsHelp: Off: bot accounts are never picked.
random.onlineHelp: Skip members who show as offline right now.

action.pickedCached: Picked from cached members only: the full member list could not be loaded right now.
action.started: Giveaway for "{prize}" started; it ends in {duration}.
action.channelGone: The channel is gone, so nothing was announced.
action.deletedMessageGone: Giveaway "{prize}" deleted (its message was already gone).
